name: Baltimore County 2024–25 regular MCAP district comparison
model_scope: Baltimore County independent 2024–25 regular MCAP grade-school district models: exact operational NCES LEA 2400120 / CCD native MD-03 / MSDE 03 identities. All 137 native E/M/EM profiles with positive September grades 3–8 and no high-grade row remain searchable. Original regular School_Level All Students All Grades Levels 3/4 published rates support 126 Math, 137 ELA and 126 independently fitted Combined results; 11 Math masks retain ELA. Precise same-year individual Early Attendance ratios use their own denominators. Accelerated Math courses and the applicable grade 6–7 waiver remain in native totals; DLM stays separate. High, mixed, primary, unknown, unmatched and closed records remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.
map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Baltimore County source release.

income_definition.label: Individual direct-certification economic disadvantage
income_definition.definition: 2024–25 individual Economically Disadvantaged Cnt divided by the same school’s own Early Attendance Total Student Cnt. Use the exact whole-school All row when native bands overlap, or the single complete school band; reconcile the published one-decimal percentage without replacing the precise count ratio. This benefits/status measure includes specified assistance/direct-certification categories and is not full household-income FRPL or universal meal receipt; identification coverage is unknown. Never replace with FARMS, September/CCD enrollment, participation, tested-subgroup income or another year. The collection as-of date is unspecified; original masks and missingness remain unavailable.

cohorts.assessment: Regular MCAP All Students All Grades published Levels 3/4 proficiency

cohorts.standard: 2021–22 four-level regular MCAP standards; 2024–25 Math includes accelerated Algebra 1, Geometry and Algebra 2 with applicable grade 6–7 course waiver; DLM remains separate
